Hi Soojin / Marissa —

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Our engineering and security teams want a short security review focused on hosting options (private VPC vs hosted), data retention, and the audit evidence Redwood can provide. Can we get a 60-minute slot next week with:

- 1x security engineer (Nigel)
- 1x platform engineer (Chris)
- 1x procurement/contract owner (Asha)

We'd prefer mornings PDT. Proposed windows: Wed 4/21 9–11am, Thu 4/22 9–11am, or Fri 4/23 10–12pm.

Also can you circulate SOC 2 summary and any redaction guidance for logs before the call? Procurement will also want a brief mutual action plan (MAP) to show milestones for onboarding.

Thanks —
